title: Nadhani ni sawa kulipia programu 2 za muziki!
label: Programu 2 za Muziki

text.According to Darwin's theory of evolutio: Kwa mujibu wa nadharia ya mageuzi ya Darwin, vitu visivyohitajika hupotea polepole kupitia mageuzi.
text.But music has never gone away, from long: Lakini muziki haujawahi kupotea, tangu zamani hadi sasa.
text.Maybe that is because music is very impo: Labda hiyo ni kwa sababu muziki ni muhimu sana kwa watu.
text.In fact, when you listen to music, you f: Kwa kweli, unaposikiliza muziki, unahisi maneno ya wimbo, na unaweza kufikiri kwamba hauko peke yako.
text.For a long time, I paid only for Spotify: Kwa muda mrefu, nililipia Spotify pekee.
text.But recently, I started paying for YouTu: Lakini hivi karibuni, nilianza kulipia YouTube Music pia.
text.This is because Spotify does not have ma: Hii ni kwa sababu Spotify haina remix nyingi au nyimbo za moja kwa moja.
text.Remixes and live songs (my feeling): Remix na nyimbo za moja kwa moja (hisia yangu)
text.On YouTube Music, you can hear the same: Kwenye YouTube Music, unaweza kusikia wimbo uleule kwa sauti tofauti.
text.It has only been about 2 weeks since I s: Zimepita takriban wiki 2 tu tangu nianze kulipia 2, lakini nina furaha sasa.
text.I do not know if this will still continu: Sijui kama hili bado litaendelea baada ya nusu mwaka.
text.But I want to use my own body to test wh: Lakini nataka kutumia mwili wangu mwenyewe kujaribu kinachotokea unapolipia programu 2 za muziki.
text.When I feel down, one music video works: Ninapohuzunika, video moja ya muziki husaidia zaidi kuliko tamthilia moja
